claims.value: Qwen3.5-9B-Base is a pre-trained causal language model with a vision encoder, designed for fine-tuning and research rather than direct interaction. It features a 9B parameter architecture with mixed linear and attention layers.
claims.evidence: This repository contains model weights and configuration files for the pre-trained only model... The intended use cases are fine-tuning... not direct interaction.
Context Length: 262,144 natively and extensible up to 1,010,000 tokens.
